schema: schema-only copy plus migration 012; synthetic records only
checks: incomplete draft is durable and invisible to catalog and stock
invalid publication rolls back without advancing draft version
concurrent repeat publishes all relations and receives stock exactly once in rubles
editing draft leaves published price unchanged and prevents repeat initial receipt
CMS child edits cause a conflict; explicit discard recovers a stale draft
duplicate article, historical slug, foreign media and missing SKU cannot overwrite catalog
new variant receives only its own initial stock; package changes leave shared packages intact
